rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a temporary alliance of parties or organizations.

example.english: To stand up to the conglomerate, several small parties formed a coalition.
example.traditional: 為咗對抗大財團，幾個小黨組成聯盟。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 deoi3 kong3 daai6 coi4 tyun4 gei2 go3 siu2 dong2 zou2 sing4 lyun4 mang4

rows.note: Use this specifically when the coalition is a government formed by multiple political parties.

example.english: After the election, the two parties worked together to form a coalition government.
example.traditional: 選舉之後，兩個政黨合作組成聯合政府。
example.jyutping: syun2 geoi2 zi1 hau6 loeng5 go3 zing3 dong2 hap6 zok3 zou2 sing4 lyun4 hap6 zing3 fu2
